newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia set for eight pct growth in 96-minister.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia set for eight pct growth in 96-minister.

text.p: Planning Minister Ginandjar Kartasasmita said on Monday he expected Indonesian economic growth of around eight percent this year.
"I think our economy is healthy and I think economic growth of around eight percent can be achieved in 1996," he told reporters on his plane after a visit to north Sumatra.

"Inflation is also under control. We hope it will be about seven percent this year and around six percent in 1997," he added. Indonesia's gross domestic product grew by 7.2 percent in 1995, while inflation was 8.6 percent.
